fb_text:
I didn't build FieldNotes to sell software. I built it so my phone would stop ringing.

I run a commercial plant service company in Atlanta — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. Offices, hotels, hospitals. My crew is out on routes every day, and for years every gate code, every client quirk, every "did anyone water the lobby at Peachtree?" came through my phone.

I looked at the field service software out there. It's built for companies with an office manager and a dispatcher. That's not me. That's probably not you either. My guys weren't going to install an app, learn a dashboard, and fill out forms between stops. Neither was I.

So I built the thing I actually needed: my crew texts like they already do, and FieldNotes turns it into service logs, instant answers ("what's the gate code at Riverside?"), and a recap the client can see after the visit.

I still run routes. I built this for my own business first — selling it came second.

Try the 60-second demo — no install, no signup: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
